title: DATESYTD with the year end "6/30" starts on July 1
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( VAR R = DATESYTD ( 'Date'[Date], "6/30" ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) ), 'Date'[Date] = DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) )

source.quote: A literal string with a date that defines the year-end date. The default is December 31.
source.supports: the second argument moves the year end
the definition: from the start of the (fiscal) year of the last date

derivation: With the year ending June 30, the year that contains 2024-02-10 began on 2023-07-01. July to December 2023 is 184 days, January 31, February 10: 225 days. Sales: 2023 Jul 1 70 + Dec 31 80 + 2024 Jan 300 + Feb 10 300 = 750 (the calendar YTD would be 600).
